lead: Sunil Dutt was a film actor, born on 6 June 1929 in Jhelum.
He died on 25 May 2005 in Mumbai at the age of 75.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of Member of the 13th Lok Sabha and Member of the 9th Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Sunil facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Sunil Dutt — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sunil Dutt was born on 6 June 1929 in Jhelum, and holds citizenship of British Raj, India and Dominion of India.

sections.heading: Sunil Dutt — Career and Professional Work
paras: Sunil Dutt works primarily as a film actor, film director, film producer and politician.
He has held the following offices: Member of the 13th Lok Sabha, Member of the 9th Lok Sabha (1989–1991) and Member of the 8th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
